objective: Integrate the physically qualified InstaVM hosted microVM provider into the provider-neutral Sandbox Fabric, connection hub, hosted render path, and live F07 proof without granting F06 worker authority.

rulesConsidered: Hosted sandboxes remain separate from Notebook Fabric and API/GPU Fabric.
Sandbox connections do not grant F06 production-worker authority.
F07 remains the physical artifact authority.
Provider credentials remain encrypted and server-side.
InstaVM session identity is the canonical runtime resource because session filesystem state is ephemeral.

notes: INSTAVM_API_KEY is consumed from encrypted connection secrets or server-only runtime environment.
Artifact download is explicitly session-bound and errors fail closed.

changes: Extended SandboxProviderType and runtimeKind for INSTAVM.
Added InstaVMSandboxAdapter with session-bound provision, execute, bounded upload, binary download, termination, and reconciliation.
Changed InstaVM connection UX from placeholder manual to guided manual onboarding.
Generalized HostedSandboxComputeProvider credential and template routing for INSTAVM.
Added InstaVM sandbox and connection contract tests.
Added InstaVM live F07 proof workflow selection and credentials.
Recorded the local physical qualification evidence and kept productionWorkerEligible=false.
Placed InstaVM ahead of paid-gated Modal in the default no-card ComputePolicy; Modal remains compatibility-only.
externalVerification: InstaVM official documentation describes Firecracker microVM isolation, session-scoped filesystem state, file upload/download, snapshots/volumes, and a no-card free tier.
Local live physical proof on 2026-10-06 rendered a 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 with 48 kHz AAC audio, downloaded it, and matched remote/local SHA-256 and byte count.
verificationPlan: Run FactoryOS strict typecheck and Sandbox/Connection tests.
Run the live hosted sandbox workflow with INSTAVM_API_KEY.
Keep F07 physical artifact verification and release guardian as the final acceptance authority.
Do not promote InstaVM to F06 production-worker eligibility.
